BIP Digital Programme

Welcome to the BIP digital programme! This site has useful information about the event and an interactive timetable where you can favourite workshops to help plan your weekend.

If this is your first time at BIP, check out the FAQs section to learn what we're all about.

You can download this site as an app onto your phone! Just open the options/sharing menu for this tab and hit "Add to Home Screen" or "Install app".
